title: Criterion instance-data constraint hints
description: criteria/<code>.hints.json. Optional constraints on the generated instance-data schema that the EA model cannot express, keyed by semantic id. Keys starting with '$' are annotations.

leafConstraints.description: Per-leaf JSON Schema refinements merged into the generated shape (e.g. { "minimum": 1 }).

leafShapes.description: Per-leaf overrides of the instance shape (e.g. { "type": "boolean" }).

optionalLeaves.description: Semantic ids of leaves relaxed to optional despite EA cardinality.
